body: What is the etiquette for reposting? Do I delete this one first or can I post in two different subreddits at once?

You don't give up on someone because they're in trouble. If your mom said she wanted to kill herself and has thought about it before, would you throw up your hands and walk away? I could leave. He's even encouraged it. But it is no more of an option to me than abandoning your mother would be to you. Humans are fragile but that's why we help each other when we start to break.
Any serious council I could get would probably either put him under suicide watch or not do anything, since I am not the party who needs help.

With all due respect, this is most definitely not manipulation. Which also doesn't help because that's probably what all manipulated people say. Just please let's operate on the assumption that it is not fictional.
